title: श्रापित घंटाघर के 4 खौफनाक नियम | भाग 1 #shorts
topic: कसौली के 120 साल पुराने घंटाघर में 13वीं घंटी बजते ही कालचक्र उलटा घूमना और मृत केयरटेकर का भयानक रहस्य।
description: कसौली के प्राचीन घंटाघर में आधी रात को 12 के बजाय 13वीं घंटी बजी और काल-चक्र उलटा घूमने लगा। समीर के सामने आया 10 साल पुराना खौफनाक सच! #HorrorShorts #HindiKahaniya #HauntedClockTower #RaatKeKisse #MysteryThriller

characters.Sameer: A 32 year old Indian male clock technician, sharp jawline, short neat black hair, dark intense eyes, wearing a dark navy blue wool sweater over a light gray shirt and dark trousers, slim athletic build.
characters.Dinanath: A 65 year old Indian male caretaker, deeply wrinkled face, thick white mustache, sparse gray hair, wearing an old dusty brown tweed jacket over a woolen shawl, frail build.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: अगर किसी प्राचीन घड़ी में आधी रात को बारह की जगह... तेरह बज जाएं, तो समझ लेना काल जाग चुका है!
scenes.style: dark, gripping, ominous narrator voice with heavy foreboding tone
scenes.visual: A 32 year old Indian male clock technician, sharp jawline, short neat black hair, dark intense eyes, wearing a dark navy blue wool sweater over a light gray shirt and dark trousers, slim athletic build, looking up anxiously at giant glowing clock gears inside an ancient misty tower room, cold moonlight through gothic windows, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: O
scenes.text: समीर बाबू... कसौली के इस घंटाघर के चार नियम याद रखना, खासकर चौथा... तेरहवीं घंटी बजते ही आँखें बंद कर लेना!
scenes.style: husky, eerie, quivering elderly voice warning with dread
scenes.visual: A 65 year old Indian male caretaker, deeply wrinkled face, thick white mustache, sparse gray hair, wearing an old dusty brown tweed jacket over a woolen shawl, frail build, holding an old brass lantern, warning sternly inside a dim stone staircase of the tower, amber lantern light casting deep shadows, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: M
scenes.text: घड़ी में तो बारह ही बजते हैं दीनानाथ जी... फिर तेरहवीं घंटी का क्या मतलब?
scenes.style: skeptical, nervous, slightly hesitant young technician voice
scenes.visual: A 32 year old Indian male clock technician, sharp jawline, short neat black hair, dark intense eyes, wearing a dark navy blue wool sweater over a light gray shirt and dark trousers, slim athletic build, standing perplexed near massive wooden cogs, holding a flashlight in the eerie gloom, cool blue shadows, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: O
scenes.text: क्योंकि वो घंटी इंसानों के लिए नहीं... मीनार के उस काले साए के लिए बजती है!
scenes.style: chilling, raspy whisper, filled with raw suppressed fear
scenes.visual: A 65 year old Indian male caretaker, deeply wrinkled face, thick white mustache, sparse gray hair, wearing an old dusty brown tweed jacket over a woolen shawl, frail build, staring wide-eyed in horror toward the tower rafters, cold blue fog swirling around his boots, dramatic low angle shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: रात ठीक बारह बजे... पेंडुलम अचानक रुक गया, और एक भयानक तेरहवीं गूंज से पूरी मीनार काँप उठी!
scenes.style: tense, escalating, breathless narration matching rising horror
scenes.visual: A 32 year old Indian male clock technician, sharp jawline, short neat black hair, dark intense eyes, wearing a dark navy blue wool sweater over a light gray shirt and dark trousers, slim athletic build, flinching in shock as massive clock weights violently vibrate, dust falling from wooden beams, eerie dim lighting, wide shot.

scenes.speaker: M
scenes.text: नहीं... सुइयां उलटी क्यों चलने लगीं? और तापमान इतना नीचे कैसे गिर गया?!
scenes.style: panting heavily, horrified, trembling with sudden cold panic
scenes.visual: A 32 year old Indian male clock technician, sharp jawline, short neat black hair, dark intense eyes, wearing a dark navy blue wool sweater over a light gray shirt and dark trousers, slim athletic build, breath freezing in white mist, stepping backward against the stone wall in pure panic, frosty moonlight, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: धुंध चीरते हुए सीढ़ियों से उतरने लगा एक खौफनाक साया... जिसकी दो सुर्ख लाल आँखें दहक रही थीं!
scenes.visual: A tall ominous translucent dark silhouette of an ancient figure inside a misty tower, glowing faint red eye-spots, uncanny tall posture, descending stone spiral stairs surrounded by thick icy mountain fog, gothic arched architecture, dramatic low angle wide shot.

scenes.speaker: M
scenes.text: दीनानाथ जी बचाइए! पर ये डायरी... हे भगवान! दीनानाथ तो दस साल पहले ही मर चुके हैं?!
scenes.style: screaming in absolute terror, staggering back, voice breaking in disbelief
scenes.visual: A 32 year old Indian male clock technician, sharp jawline, short neat black hair, dark intense eyes, wearing a dark navy blue wool sweater over a light gray shirt and dark trousers, slim athletic build, dropping a yellowed old diary on the floor in pure shock, flashlight shaking violently, dark eerie shadows, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: G
scenes.text: चौथा नियम टूट गया समीर... अब तुम्हारा वक्त खत्म!
scenes.style: deep, echoing, demonic and unnervingly close whisper
scenes.visual: A tall ominous translucent dark silhouette of an ancient figure inside a misty tower, glowing faint red eye-spots, uncanny tall posture, towering menacingly over the clock mechanism room as shadows stretch unnaturally across the stone walls, cold moonlight and ominous darkness, wide shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: आगे क्या हुआ? पूरी कहानी देखने के लिए नीचे दिए गए वीडियो पर क्लिक करें!
scenes.style: compelling, urgent, perfectly timed cliffhanger hook
scenes.visual: A 32 year old Indian male clock technician, sharp jawline, short neat black hair, dark intense eyes, wearing a dark navy blue wool sweater over a light gray shirt and dark trousers, slim athletic build, turning terrified toward the camera as giant clock hands spin wildly in background, blue atmospheric mist, medium shot.
